description: Reads what a customer can see in their Otovo portal, one view at a time. Changes nothing. With a scheduling code and no account, three views: booking_status (the address, services offered, the visit already scheduled and whether it can be moved or cancelled, open access questions, the support line), booking_options (code and service_type, optional week_start, location_id and promo_code: bookable times for a new visit, best first, with the price and what the promo code does) and reschedule_options (code, optional week_start: times the scheduled visit can move to). With a connected account, site_id selects one of the customer's sites when they have several: sites, profile, home, summary; monitoring (production now, equipment status, alerts and when each reading was taken; a missing or stale reading is not zero production), monitoring_page, monitoring_history (node_id, query range day|week|month|year and date), monitoring_devices (node_id), monitoring_device (node_id, device_id), monitoring_energy_rate; connect_system (the monitoring providers Otovo connects, the fields each connection needs and the portal's setup steps; id = one provider); energy, energy_usage (query start_date, end_date, granularity), energy_bills, energy_plans; service (visits, work orders, bookable services), appointment (id), appointment_tracking (id: where the crew is on the day), scheduling (what can be booked or moved, open access questions), booking_options (service_type, optional week_start and promo_code) and reschedule_options (optional week_start); work_order (id), repair (id), site_report (id; photos stay in the portal); quotes, quote (id); billing, billing_records (query limit, cursor), billing_record (id; the invoice PDF is a portal link), payment_methods, subscription, subscription_plans, subscription_terms (query tier, billing_interval); documents (pending, signed, project and historical); leases, lease (id); hour_bank; notification_settings. Reading booking times for a connected customer can create their own Otovo scheduler link; nothing is sent to them. Serves every Otovo region: without a connected account the scheduling code, preview or address selects the region; a connected customer is served where their account lives.

code.description: Without an account: the customer's scheduling code, the last part of the otovo.com/book/... link they were sent. It cannot be looked up from other details.

id.description: The record a single-record view is about: an appointment, work order, site report, quote, billing record (its quote id), lease (project id), or a provider key for connect_system.

location_id.description: booking_options: which property, when the booking covers more than one.

node_id.description: A monitoring node from view monitoring (monitoring_history, monitoring_devices, monitoring_device).

promo_code.description: booking_options: a promo code the customer gave. The answer's charge is the price with it and promo says whether it applied, their Otovo Care discount is larger, or why it was refused.

query.description: Extra filters the view takes, as named in the description: for example {"range":"month","date":"2026-10-01"} for monitoring_history, {"limit":20} for billing_records, {"tier":"care"} for subscription_terms.

service_type.description: booking_options: the kind of new visit. booking_status or view scheduling lists what is actually offered.

site_id.description: Connected customers: one of their own sites, a site_id from view sites. Needed when they have more than one.

view.description: What to read. See the tool description for what each view holds and which parameters it takes.

week_start.description: booking_options, reschedule_options: earliest date to search from, YYYY-MM-DD. Step it forward a week at a time to look further out.

name: get_my_otovo
title: My Otovo
